items.title: Scott Jimmy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The old bands – Tommy Dorsey, Benny Goodman, and others who I call champions of the music

ctx.x: Let’s go back a little bit, and we’ll talk more about Lionel a little bit later. But I was interested in the early part of your life, when music was beginning to enter into your heart for the first time, when you were a little boy.

Oh, yeah, yeah, yeah. You see, we didn’t have record players or nothing. They couldn’t afford it. So where our music came from was radio. We would all get around that radio when the music was being played. The old bands – Tommy Dorsey, Benny Goodman, and others who I call champions of the music . . .
